lines.1: The test was tomorrow, so it was time to study hard!
lines.2: But there was some annoying pest hanging around.
lines.3: Whatever. I'd ignore her and keep studying.
lines.4: 「Time to check my answers... Question one, right. Two, right. Three, wrong...」
lines.6: 「Let's see, the explanation for question three... Oh, so that's how it works.」
lines.11: 「Sitting there studying your ass off all by yourself!」
lines.12: 「I'm gonna get in your way. If we go down, we go down together. Heh heh heh heh.」
lines.13: W-what a completely rotten excuse for a human being.
lines.16: She had a tray with tea and snacks in one hand.
lines.17: 「I thought I'd bring Leo something while he worked hard, but Kanisawa...」
lines.19: 「If you're free, shall I tutor you?」
lines.24: Otome cut her off and blocked her escape.
lines.25: 「The tests start Monday. You can still work hard starting now.」
lines.26: 「Come along, Kanisawa. As your senior, I'll drill it into you properly.」
lines.27: Crab was dragged away across the floor.
lines.28: 「Ugwah! Leo, don't think you've won just because of this!」
lines.30: 「Even if I'm gone, someday a second me, a third me will--」
lines.31: Crab vanished while shouting defiance to the very end.
lines.32: 「Hmph. As if there could ever be a second or third Crab.」
lines.33: 「Yo! It's your buddy, everybody's idol, Shark!」
lines.35: Fukahire climbed in through the window carrying some kind of book.
lines.36: 「I got my hands on a new sexy-type book.」
lines.37: What the hell was a "sexy-type book"?
lines.38: 「As proof of our friendship, I thought I'd let you see it first.」
lines.39: 「So YOU came to distract me too.」
lines.40: 「Now that you've figured me out, I've got no choice! You're coming down with me!」
lines.41: 「You only sound cool when you're saying completely useless crap like that.」
lines.42: Why were all my friends like this...?
lines.52: 「Heh heh. I signed up for a dating site, so I win this one.」
lines.54: 「Come on, today's the day you introduce me to the perfect girl!」
lines.55: "From: Pe Chiruchiru. That celebrity did THIS... and THAT too!? For details, click the site below!*"
lines.56: 「Waaaaah! All I ever get is spam!!」
